searchDocs.title: Installation and Start
searchDocs.content: Installation and Start Download the varsql-[latest_version].zip file from Releases Extract the zip file. Move to the [extracted folder]/varsql-app-[latest version]/bin folder. If the Java version installed by default on your local system is not compatible with the Java version required by varsql, download and install a new Java version, then configure the path. If you want to use the default Java, proceed to step 5. For Windows Open the setenv.bat file and remove the comment (`rem`). Set the JAVA_HOME path. For Linux Open the setenv.sh file and remove the comment (`#`). Set the JAVA_HOME path. Start For Windows startup.bat <-- Click For Linux ./startup.sh Open the browser Open the browser at http://localhost:12312/varsql

searchDocs.title: JRE_HOME on Execution​
searchDocs.content: Execution:  Windows: [extracted_path]/bin/startup.batLinux: [extracted_path]/bin/startup.sh  This issue occurs when the JRE_HOME system variable is not registered. The log message will be: "The JRE_HOME environment variable is not defined correctly. This environment variable is needed to run this program." Action: Right-click on My Computer -> Click Properties -> Advanced System Settings -> Click Environment Variables Click New and enter the following:

searchDocs.title: JAVA_HOME​
searchDocs.content: Variable Name: JAVA_HOME Variable Value: [Add the Java installation path here and confirm] e.g., C:\Java\zulu

searchDocs.title: JRE_HOME​
searchDocs.content: Variable Name: JRE_HOME Variable Value: [Add the Java installation path here and confirm] e.g., C:\Java\zulu\jre
